description: Pledge a payment on a task list: when the list is verified complete (every task done + photo evidence on photo-required tasks), the payer automatically receives a Stripe pay link that routes the money DIRECTLY to the worker (0% TaScan fee). No money moves and no card is stored at pledge time. The worker must have completed payout onboarding (Get Paid on their profile).

idempotency_key.description: B1: optional replay key (up to 1024 chars, no braces) sent verbatim as the Idempotency-Key header instead of a fresh one per call — a retried call with the SAME key replays the original pledge instead of creating a second one.

memo.description: What the payment is for (shown to the payer)

payer_email.description: Who pays — receives the pay link on verification

task_list_id.description: Task list the payment is tied to

name: tascan_request_payment
